name: Four-game PPO reward comparison for genuine TH17 Power pickups above credit high-water mark
initialization: Restore all actor and critic parameters of the first joint four-game PPO update. Fresh trajectories from this exact actor. Same deployed full-action camera interface, game reward and eight-stratum balancing.
controls: No geometry, aim, automatic shoot, automatic bomb, programmed movement route or Continue. Raw original 112x96 grayscale camera and preceding absolute-difference image. One categorical movement head and three independent focus, shot and bomb heads.
frozen: Sixteen new TH17 controller seeds. Eight paired full-life original games per difficulty. Keep original game setting, same physical host and instance within each pair. Report Stage2, effective Bomb casts, last playable stock, native progression and Power maximum. Test outcomes are produced by the original game; the Power bonus never changes policy inputs.
reward: TH10, TH12 and TH13 retain the previous validated native event rewards. TH17 uses -1 per lost life, +1 per genuine life gained, +2 on first native entry to each new stage, -0.03 only on same-life consumed Bomb stock, +0.001 per 60 previously unseen active native ticks if that clock is independently qualified. Without a qualified clock omit TH17 dense time reward from all arms, record that choice before the first TRAIN credit.
endpoints: Per-title, per-difficulty Stage 2 arrival and stocks at first arrival, terminal stocks, genuine casts, native script progress when qualified, and 95 percent uncertainty by paired seed. TH10 spends Power in place of a Bomb stock.
exclusion: No held or engineering credit contributes gradients. Do not impute completed credits or promote an unqualified title. At most 3 stages in these original trial builds.
rollout_budget: 64 new full-stock original credits for training. No reuse of earlier trajectories. Dispatch on freed lanes after existing assignments.
intervention: During TH17 TRAIN only add 0.05 reward for each 1.00 Power increase beyond the running high-water mark. Initialize from actual opening stock, exclude opening and life resets, count only real original increases after a policy decision. No credit for recovering to an earlier maximum. Cap the total positive bonus at 0.15 for a credit. All other rewards and PPO parameters match generation two.
accounting: Reuse exactly the same 64 original TRAIN trajectories from generation one actor/critic that produced generation two. No additional on-policy credit counted. This bonus changes the training objective and can favor pickups even when survival is unaffected.
